evidence: The structure of thin films was studied with reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) and X-ray diffraction (XRD). The composition of the films was investigated using the electron probe microanalysis (EPMA) method. The film thickness, t, was determined from spectral oscillations of optical transmission and from ellipsometry data. The apparent volume-weighted X-ray crystallite size was estimated by peak shape Voigt decomposition method.
